motivation: The pinned native video API supplies a geometric prompt on the initial frame only. With no text, later frames disallow new detections, so default consecutive-detection confirmation can suppress initial targets. Native visual-only runs returned zero reviewed observations. This extension is experimental feature reuse, not a claim that the official image visual prompt fails.
implementation: Encode the same automatic initial YOLO exemplar through SAM3 geometry_encoder once. Detach and retain its token embeddings and mask; supply them through _encode_prompt visual_prompt_embed/visual_prompt_mask on every detector frame, with an empty current geometric prompt. For visual-only mode, enable later new-object admission without changing text embeddings or thresholds. No weights change.
development: All nine fixed hybrid development clips. Same highest-confidence eligible initial-box selection.
selection: Compare the three variants and native person baseline using correct-10*wrong, then coverage, then fewer uncertain joins; prefer default on ties. Freeze one choice before reused tracking regression.
limitations: The cached geometry tokens include position and appearance; this is an experimental template and may overfocus on the initial team or location. No reference labels enter inference.
